question: Which country hosted the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Ministers meeting in October 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is **__India.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India hosted the 19th Meeting of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Ministers of Foreign Economy and Foreign Trade on 28 October 2020.**
 
• In the meeting, four documents were adopted. They include a statement on the response to COVID-19.
 
• Besides, a statement on SCO Cooperation on Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) was also adopted.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO)** was established as a multilateral association to ensure security and maintain stability across the vast Eurasian region.
 
• It envisages joining forces to counteract emerging challenges and threats among other nations.
 
• It also promotes enhancing trade, as well as cultural and humanitarian cooperation among the members.
 
• The current Secretary-General is** Vladimir Norov of Uzbekistan**, who assumed his office on** 1 January 2019.**
